# Each approved difference applies to one comparison.
# Each line has five tab-separated fields.
#   comparison <TAB> language <TAB> grammar blob SHA-256 <TAB> witness SHA-256 <TAB> approval reference
# For fresh_tree the witness is the input SHA-256.
# For c_incremental_vs_fresh hash four newline-separated values in this order.
# The C runtime commit, input SHA-256, incremental C tree digest, fresh C tree digest.
# The list starts empty.
